```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)
library(ggtext)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)

img_dir <- "../docs/img"

# Ore icons on the x-axis
ore_label <- function(kind, size = 30) {
  if (kind == "none") {
    glue("<img src='{img_dir}/stone.png' width='{size}' style='opacity:0.55;' />")
  } else {
    glue("<img src='{img_dir}/{kind}.png' width='{size}' />")
  }
}
ore_labels <- setNames(
  vapply(c("none","coal","copper","iron","diamond"), ore_label, character(1)),
  c("none","coal","copper","iron","diamond")
)

biome_labels <- c(
  overworld = "Overworld",
  cave      = "Cave",
  deep      = "Deep Cave"
)

data |>
  filter(comparison_type != "bad_to_good") |>
  mutate(
    biome = factor(biome, levels = c("overworld","cave","deep")),
    outcome_kind = factor(outcome_kind, levels = c("none","coal","copper","iron","diamond"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = outcome_kind, y = regret, fill = feedback, color = feedback)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    aes(group = interaction(outcome_kind, feedback)),
    adjust = 0.5, justification = 0, scale = 0.4,
    .width = 0, point_colour = NA, alpha = .5,
    slab_linewidth = 0.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = .7)
  ) +
  ggdist::stat_dots(
    aes(group = interaction(outcome_kind, feedback)),
    side = "right", justification = 0,
    binwidth = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = .7)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = feedback),
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot, conf.int = .95, B = 5000,
    geom = "pointrange",
    linewidth = 1, size = 1, shape = 21,
    position = position_dodge(width = .7)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ biome, labeller = as_labeller(biome_labels)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ore_labels, expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("partial" = "#6c7a89", "full"  = "#3aa05a"),
    labels = c("Partial", "Full"),
    name   = "Feedback"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("partial" = "#2f3a47", "full"  = "#1f6b3a"),
    labels = c("Partial", "Full"),
    name   = "Feedback"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Regret rating (0–100)",
    title    = "Regret by mined outcome, broken out by biome and feedback type",
    subtitle = "Each dot is one trial · pointranges are mean ± 95% bootstrap CI"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x          = ggtext::element_markdown(margin = margin(t = 4)),
    axis.ticks.x         = element_blank(),
    strip.text           = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12,
                                        margin = margin(t = 6, b = 6)),
    strip.background     = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
    panel.spacing.x      = unit(18, "pt"),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.position      = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    plot.title           = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle        = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10,
                                        margin = margin(b = 10))
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)
library(ggtext)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)

# ---- Shared setup ---------------------------------------------------------
img_dir <- "../docs/img"

ore_label <- function(kind, size = 28) {
  if (kind == "none") {
    glue("<img src='{img_dir}/stone.png' width='{size}' style='opacity:0.55;' />")
  } else {
    glue("<img src='{img_dir}/{kind}.png' width='{size}' />")
  }
}
ore_labels <- setNames(
  vapply(c("none","coal","copper","iron","diamond"), ore_label, character(1)),
  c("none","coal","copper","iron","diamond")
)

biome_labels <- c(overworld = "Overworld", cave = "Cave", deep = "Deep Cave")

feedback_fill   <- c(partial = "#6c7a89", full = "#3aa05a")
feedback_colour <- c(partial = "#2f3a47", full = "#1f6b3a")

# pre-process once
d <- data |>
  mutate(
    biome         = factor(biome, levels = c("overworld","cave","deep")),
    outcome_kind  = factor(outcome_kind,  levels = c("none","coal","copper","iron","diamond")),
    best_alt_kind = factor(best_alt_kind, levels = c("none","coal","copper","iron","diamond")),
    salience_count = factor(salience_count, levels = c(0, 2, 8),
                            labels = c("0 (none)", "2 (little)", "8 (a lot)")),
    best_alt_adjacent = factor(best_alt_adjacent,
                               levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
                               labels = c("Not adjacent", "Adjacent"))
  )

base_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks.x         = element_blank(),
    strip.text           = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12,
                                        margin = margin(t = 6, b = 6)),
    strip.background     = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
    panel.spacing        = unit(18, "pt"),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.position      = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    plot.title           = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle        = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10,
                                        margin = margin(b = 10))
  )


# ============================================================================
# 1. Regret × salience count × feedback (faceted by biome)
#    Does seeing more "shortlisted" alternatives change regret?
# ============================================================================



# ============================================================================
# 2. Regret × best_alt_kind (what was the best block they could have mined?)
#    Faceted by feedback — does knowing the alternative matter?
# ============================================================================
p_best_alt_kind <- d |>
  filter(!is.na(best_alt_kind)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = best_alt_kind, y = regret, fill = feedback, color = feedback)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    aes(group = interaction(best_alt_kind, feedback)),
    adjust = 0.5, justification = 0, scale = 0.4,
    .width = 0, point_colour = NA, alpha = .5,
    slab_linewidth = 0.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = .7)
  ) +
  ggdist::stat_dots(
    aes(group = interaction(best_alt_kind, feedback)),
    side = "right", justification = 0,
    binwidth = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = .7)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = feedback),
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot, conf.int = .95, B = 5000,
    geom = "pointrange",
    linewidth = 1, size = 1, shape = 21,
    position = position_dodge(width = .7)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ biome, labeller = as_labeller(biome_labels)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ore_labels, expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = feedback_fill,    name = "Feedback",
                    labels = c("Partial","Full")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = feedback_colour, name = "Feedback",
                     labels = c("Partial","Full")) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Regret rating (0–100)",
    title    = "Regret by the best block they could have mined",
    subtitle = "X-axis = best alternative across the full board · dots = trials"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(margin = margin(t = 4)))


# ============================================================================
# 3. Regret as a function of the chosen-vs-best gap (best_alt_payout − outcome_payout)
#    A continuous regret-by-counterfactual-gap relationship, colored by feedback.
# ============================================================================
p_gap <- d |>
  mutate(gap_to_best_alt = best_alt_value - outcome_value) |>
  filter(!is.na(gap_to_best_alt)) |>
  filter(feedback == "full") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gap_to_best_alt, y = regret)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.18, height = 0, alpha = 0.35, size = 1.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.18, se = TRUE) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = feedback),
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot, conf.int = .95, B = 5000,
    geom = "pointrange", linewidth = 1, size = 0.9, shape = 21,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cf_gap) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = feedback_fill,    name = "Feedback",
  #                   labels = c("Partial","Full")) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = feedback_colour, name = "Feedback",
  #                    labels = c("Partial","Full")) +
  labs(
    x = "Gap to best alternative (best_alt_payout − outcome_payout)",
    y = "Regret rating (0–100)",
    title    = "Regret scales with the gap between what you got and the best you could have gotten",
    subtitle = "Black pointranges = mean ± 95% bootstrap CI at each integer gap"
  ) +
  base_theme


# ============================================================================
# 4. Regret × best_alt_adjacent (was the best block right next to mine?)
#    Spatial-proximity effect — feels worse when you "almost" got it.
# ============================================================================
p_adjacent <- d |>
  filter(!is.na(best_alt_adjacent)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = best_alt_adjacent, y = regret, fill = feedback, color = feedback)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    aes(group = interaction(best_alt_adjacent, feedback)),
    adjust = 0.5, justification = 0, scale = 0.45,
    .width = 0, point_colour = NA, alpha = .5,
    slab_linewidth = 0.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = .7)
  ) +
  ggdist::stat_dots(
    aes(group = interaction(best_alt_adjacent, feedback)),
    side = "right", justification = 0,
    binwidth = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = .7)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = feedback),
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot, conf.int = .95, B = 5000,
    geom = "pointrange", linewidth = 1, size = 1, shape = 21,
    position = position_dodge(width = .7)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ biome, labeller = as_labeller(biome_labels)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = feedback_fill,    name = "Feedback",
                    labels = c("Partial","Full")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = feedback_colour, name = "Feedback",
                     labels = c("Partial","Full")) +
  labs(
    x = "Best alternative spatial proximity",
    y = "Regret rating (0–100)",
    title    = "Does it feel worse when the best block was right next to yours?",
    subtitle = "Adjacent = the best alternative shares an edge with the mined block"
  ) +
  base_theme


# ============================================================================
# 5. Heatmap of mean regret across outcome × best_alt (the full 5×5 grid)
#    Diagonal = you picked the best · upper triangle = better alternatives existed.
# ============================================================================
p_heatmap <- d |>
  filter(!is.na(outcome_kind), !is.na(best_alt_kind)) |>
  group_by(outcome_kind, best_alt_kind) |>
  filter(feedback == "full") |>
  summarise(mean_regret = mean(regret, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = dplyr::n(),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = best_alt_kind, y = outcome_kind, fill = mean_regret)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(mean_regret), "",
                               sprintf("%.0f\n(n=%d)", mean_regret, n)),
                color = mean_regret > 55),
            size = 3.4, lineheight = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey20", "TRUE" = "white")) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1, na.value = "grey92",
                       name = "Mean regret") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ore_labels, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = ore_labels, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    x = "Best block they could have mined",
    y = "Block they actually mined",
    title    = "Mean regret by mined outcome × best-available alternative",
    subtitle = "Diagonal = you mined the best block · cell numbers = mean regret (trial n)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(margin = margin(t = 4)),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(margin = margin(r = 4)),
    panel.grid  = element_blank()
  )


# ============================================================================
# 6. Full-feedback only: regret as a function of revealed CF gap (cf_max_diff),
#    split by comparison_type — the actual counterfactual that participants saw.
# ============================================================================
p_cf <- d |>
  filter(feedback == "full",
         comparison_type %in% c("good_to_bad", "bad_to_good")) |>
  mutate(
    comparison_type = factor(
      comparison_type,
      levels = c("good_to_bad", "bad_to_good"),
      labels = c("Chosen > revealed CFs", "Chosen < revealed CFs")
    )
  ) |>
  filter(salience_count == 2 | 8) |>
  mutate(cf_max_diff = outcome_value - best_alt_value) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cf_max_diff, y = regret, color = comparison_type, fill = comparison_type)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.45, size = 1.8) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = comparison_type),
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot, conf.int = .95, B = 5000,
    geom = "pointrange", linewidth = 1.1, size = 1, shape = 21,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ biome, labeller = as_labeller(biome_labels)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = -4:4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Chosen > revealed CFs" = "#3aa05a",
               "Chosen < revealed CFs" = "#c0524a"),
    name = "Counterfactual direction"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Chosen > revealed CFs" = "#1f6b3a",
               "Chosen < revealed CFs" = "#7a2620"),
    name = "Counterfactual direction"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Focal CF − chosen payout (cf_max_diff)",
    y = "Regret rating (0–100)",
    title    = "Counterfactual feedback drives regret on full-feedback trials",
    subtitle = "Positive cf_max_diff = revealed alternative was better · only full-feedback consider trials"
  ) +
  base_theme


# Print individually, or stitch with patchwork:
# library(patchwork)
# (p_salience / p_best_alt_kind) | (p_gap / p_adjacent) | (p_heatmap / p_cf)
p_salience
p_best_alt_kind
p_gap
p_adjacent
p_heatmap
p_cf
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)
library(dplyr)

biome_labels <- c(overworld = "Overworld", cave = "Cave", deep = "Deep Cave")

data |>
  filter(feedback == "partial") |>
  mutate(biome = factor(biome, levels = c("overworld","cave","deep"))) |>
  filter(!is.na(regret)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = biome, y = regret, fill = biome, color = biome)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 0.5, justification = -0.05, scale = 0.55,
    .width = 0, point_colour = NA, alpha = 0.55,
    slab_linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  ggdist::stat_dots(
    side = "left", justification = 1.1,
    binwidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot, conf.int = .95, B = 5000,
    geom = "pointrange",
    linewidth = 1.1, size = 1, shape = 21, color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = biome_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(overworld = "#9ec97d",
                               cave      = "#7e8a99",
                               deep      = "#3a4256"),
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(overworld = "#5a7a3f",
                                cave      = "#3f4856",
                                deep      = "#1c2030"),
                     guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Regret rating (0–100)",
    title    = "Regret by biome",
    subtitle = "Dots = trials · pointrange = mean ± 95% bootstrap CI"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome_kind) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks.x       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10,
                                      margin = margin(b = 10))
  )
```
